product.title: Absolut Curve
product.body_html:
Tough look? Check.

Aggressive Roll? Check.

Devastating backend reaction? You bet.

Absolut Curve has everything that Hammer bowlers want. With the combination of the new FatMax core shape and our H-150 Crosscover Reactive shell, the Absolut Curve gives Hammer bowlers the most angular mid-price ball from the Hammer line in years.

Nothing Hits Like A Hammer!
